stepExplanation:
Using the **10% Rule**:

If only 10% of energy passes to the next level, and snakes receive 100 kJ:
- Mice must have 100 kJ / 0.10 = **1000 kJ** available

This can also be read directly from the pyramid:
- Mice (primary consumers) = 1000 kJ
- Snakes (secondary consumers) = 100 kJ
- This confirms the 10% transfer rule: 1000 kJ x 10% = 100 kJ
stepBody: If only 10% of energy transfers to the next level, how much energy (in kJ) must the mice consume from grass to have 100 kJ available for snakes?
